description: This file defines a Java class 'FormulasPane' responsible for rendering and updating mathematical formulas related to engine tuning parameters in a GUI. It utilizes LaTeX formulas, dynamically fetches sensor data, and updates the displayed formulas at regular intervals. It also includes UI controls for pausing updates and saving images.

classes.name: FormulasPane
classes.description: A GUI component that displays dynamically updated engine formulas with support for LaTeX rendering, including controls for pausing updates and saving images.

methods.name: FormulasPane
methods.description: Constructor initializing the GUI components, setting up timers for formula updates, and configuring control buttons.

methods.name: updateFormula
methods.description: Updates the displayed formula based on current sensor and configuration data, generating LaTeX content and rendering it.

methods.name: getAccelerationVariables
methods.description: Generates LaTeX-formatted variables related to acceleration based on sensor data.

methods.name: getSpeedDensity
methods.description: Constructs LaTeX formulas for speed-density mode engine calculation parameters.

methods.name: getInjecctorLag
methods.description: Returns a LaTeX-formatted string for injector lag based on sensor voltage.

methods.name: oneDecimal
methods.description: Formats a sensor value with one decimal place.

methods.name: twoDecimals
methods.description: Formats a sensor value with two decimal places.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing the formulas and controls.
